act: Indian Stamp Act, 1899 (as applicable to Delhi), Schedule I-A

source.ref: Indian Stamp Act, 1899, Sch. I-A Art. 35 (Delhi)
source.quoted_text: Sch I-A Art. 35 (both columns): 'LEASE including an under-lease or sub-lease and any agreement to let or sub-let — (a) where rent is fixed and no premium: (i) term < 1 year → same duty as Bond (No.15) for the whole amount payable under such lease; (ii) term ≥ 1 but ≤ 5 years → same duty as Bond (No.15) on the average annual rent; (iii) term > 5 but ≤ 10 years → same duty as Conveyance (No.23) on the average annual rent; (iv) term > 10 but ≤ 20 years → Conveyance on TWICE the average annual rent; (v) term > 20 but ≤ 30 years → Conveyance on THRICE the average annual rent; (vi) [next band, OCR reads "exceeding 100 years" but sequence implies > 30 ≤ 100] → Conveyance on 4 TIMES the average annual rent; (vii) term > 100 years or in perpetuity → same duty as Conveyance [base text truncated in source]; (viii) no definite term → Conveyance on 3 times average annual rent [for the first ten years]. (b) premium and no rent → Conveyance on the premium; (c) premium in addition to rent → Conveyance on the premium IN ADDITION to the rent-based duty.' Founder sanity check (Q2): '<1 year = 2% of the whole rent payable' matches the universally-quoted Delhi 11-month agreement figure.

notes_for_reviewer: CONFIDENCE: MEDIUM-HIGH for bands (i)–(v) and premium clauses; band (vi) boundary (encoded > 30y ≤ 100y → 4× AAR) is OCR-AMBIGUOUS in the source ('exceeding 100 years' where sequence implies >30≤100) — VERIFY. Term > 100 years / PERPETUITY deliberately has NO case: the engine throws (escalate-by-error) because the perpetuity base text is truncated in the source (central Sch I uses 1/5 of first-50-years' rent; Delhi text unverified) and perpetuity leases also attract DMC transfer duty on 1/6 of first-50-years' rent (founder Q1) — encode both only after founder supplies the clean text. CONVENTIONS: term_months is an integer (11-month L&L = 11 → band i; 12 months = 1 year → band ii, matching '<1 year' vs 'not less than 1 year'); inputs: term_months, avg_annual_rent (bands ii–vi), total_rent_payable (band i), premium (always required — pass 0 if none). Transfer duty: NOT attached — only a lease IN PERPETUITY is in the DMC s.147 list (founder Q1: 'a 6-year lease gets 3% stamp and no transfer duty'). Cross-refs import the Art 23 charge only; callers should omit transferee_category for leases pending verification that the women reduction extends beyond purchases.

source.ref: Indian Stamp Act, 1899, Sch. I-A Art. 35 (Delhi) — 'any agreement to let'
source.quoted_text: Sch I-A Art. 35 opens: 'LEASE including an under-lease or sub-lease and ANY AGREEMENT TO LET or sub-let'. A leave-&-license conferring occupation of premises against periodic payment is charged in Delhi practice as an agreement to let under Art 35 (Delhi has no separate leave-&-license article, unlike Maharashtra Art 36A). Duty follows the lease bands — the common 11-month L&L: 2% of the whole license fee payable (via Bond No.15).

notes_for_reviewer: CONFIDENCE: MEDIUM. Statutory hook is Art 35's 'any agreement to let' language; PENDING_VERIFICATION that Delhi registrar practice charges L&L under Art 35 in all cases (the classification tree already escalates license-with-exclusive-possession grey zones). Same inputs as lease (term_months, license fee as rent). A true bare license without occupation rights may instead be an Art 5 agreement (Rs 50) — that fork belongs in the questionnaire; confirm before adding.
